title: What Winning Actually Earns You
intro: Alongside the formal grade, Mesa runs a set of first-to-hit and sustained-performance awards. They're a concrete reason to pick a channel and push on it, instead of drifting.

groups.name: Channel milestones
groups.tagline: First team to hit it wins.

awards.reward: Meta coins · Mesa LinkedIn post, plus a post from Varun

awards.achievement: First to ₹20K revenue through performance marketing
First to 10K followers on your business page

groups.name: Revenue milestones
groups.tagline: The big numbers, rewarded in kind.

awards.achievement: First to ₹10L revenue within the 8 weeks
Biggest weekly improvement — awarded every week, Week 4 to Week 8
awards.reward: Flea stall priority · WeWork stall · cash prizes

awards.achievement: Stay in the top 3 on revenue for 7 consecutive days

play: Biggest weekly improvement rewards your delta, not your absolute revenue, and it resets every week from Week 4. Whatever the leaderboard says, this one is always winnable.
The channel awards force focus. If you're spread thin, pick one and chase it — that's the channel discipline that moves your revenue anyway.
Top 3 for 7 consecutive days rewards consistency over a single spike. One good week that goes quiet doesn't count.
note: Some reward details are still being finalised by the programme team. This page updates as they're locked in.
